spans.s: वध्रि f. A leathern thong.
वध्री f. A leathern strap.
वध् vt. 1P (pres. वधति) To kill. (This root is not used in classical Sanskrit except as a substitute of हन्, in certain tenses and moods.)
वाध् vt. 1Ā (pp. वाधित; pres. वाधते) The same as बाध् q.v.
वध m. 1. Slaughter, killing, murder, वधाय वध्यस्य शरं शरण्यः R.ii.80, xii.52; 2. blow, stroke; 3. paralysis; 4. multiplication (in math.).
वाध m. The same as बाध q.v.
वाधा f. The same as बाधा q.v.
वध-अंगक n. a prison.
वध-उपाय m. a means of putting to death.
वध-क्रम m. the process of killing.
वध-जीविन् m. 1. a hunter; 2. a butcher.
वध-दंड m. 1. corporeal punishment; 2. capital punishment.
वध-भूमि ऋ।, -स्थली ऋ।, -स्थान म्। f. 1. place of execution; 2. a slaughter-house.
वध-भूमि ऋ।, -स्थली ऋ।, -स्थान म्। f. 1. place of execution; 2. a slaughter-house.
वध-स्थान m. 1. place of execution; 2. a slaughter-house.
वध-स्तंभ m. gallows.
वधक m. 1. An executioner; 2. a murderer.
वाधक a. (f. धिका) The same as बाधक q.v.
वधत्र n. A deadly weapon.
वधित्र n. 1. The god of love; 2. sexual passion.
वधु f. 1. A daughter-in-law; 2. a young woman in general.

वधू f. 1. the female of any animal, e.g. व्याघ्रवधू, मृगवधू; 2. a bride, वरः स वध्या सह राजमार्गे प्राप ध्वजच्छायनिवारितोष्णम् R.viii.4, 19; 3. a woman in general, स्वयशांसि विक्रमवतामवतांं न वधूष्वघानि विमृषंति धियः Kir.vi.45, Megh.i.16, 47; 4. a wife, वधूर्भक्तिमती चैनामर्चितामातपोवनात् R.i.90; 5. a daughter-in-law, तेषां वधूस्त्वमसि नंदिनि पार्थिवानां येषां कुलेषु सविता च गुरुर्वयं च Ut.i.; 6. the wife of a younger relation.
वधु f. 1. A daughter-in-law; 2. a young woman in general.
वधू-गृहप्रवेश, -प्रवेश m. the ceremony of a bride’s entrance into the house of her husband.
वधू-गृहप्रवेश, -प्रवेश m. the ceremony of a bride’s entrance into the house of her husband.
वधू-जन m. a female, a woman.
वधू-पक्ष m. the party of the bride at a wedding ceremony.
वधू-वस्त्र n. bridal apparel.
वधूटी f. 1. A young female, a young woman, गोपवधूटीदुकूलचोराय Bh.P.; 2. a daughter-in-law.
वध्य (I) a. (f. ध्या) 1. To be killed; 2. to be punished corporally.
वध्य (II) m. An enemy.
वध्य (I) a. (f. ध्या) 1. To be killed; 2. to be punished corporally.
वध्या f. Murder, killing.
वध्य-पटह m. a drum beaten at the time of execution.
वध्य-भू ऋ।, -भूमि ऋ।, -स्थान न्। f. a place of execution.
वध्य-भू ऋ।, -भूमि ऋ।, -स्थान न्। f. a place of execution.
वध्य-स्थान n. a place of execution.
वध्य-माला f. a garland placed on a person about to be executed.
वध्र n. 1. A leathern thong; 2. lead.
वध्र्य m. A shoe.
वाधक a. (f. धिका) The same as बाधक q.v.
वाधन n. The same as बाधन q.v.
वाधना f. The same as बाधना q.v.
वाधूक्य n. A marriage.
वाध्रीणस m. A rhinoceros.
